selection.seed_policy: Use only the first preregistered seed 81042; no best-seed selection.
selection.scope: Known-entity canonical C updates only, covering edited positions 0, 1, 2.
selection.rule: After inspecting completed development outputs, select one first-word partial reconstruction case, one all-grouped-target-hit middle-word improvement case, and one full-route stale-A third-word case. These are illustrative cases, not a random or representative sample.

definitions.first_mass: Target-fact attention weight at the prefill final position predicting the first generated token.
definitions.decode_mass: Arithmetic mean across subsequent actual free-generation prediction positions, including the EOS-prediction step when present.
definitions.word_correct: Only an output with exactly three normalized words can receive per-position credit.
definitions.routing_scope: Recorded generated-token trajectories; no alignment to gold word positions and no causal attribution from attention weights alone.

limitations: All selected C strict EM values are zero. Examples are not a replacement for complete per-arm/seed denominators or sealed gates.
The first three primary rows hold grouped lookup fixed while contrasting training regime/readout. Additive is an ineligible diagnostic, not a VeRA success.
Known/new entity datasets deliberately share payloads; these examples use only known entities and do not establish new-entity generalization.
Target fact mass near one proves recorded reads concentrate on that fact, not that its edited slot receives useful weight or its content is decoded correctly.
Decoding position masses include EOS and are not assigned to the gold first/second/third word.
